row.name: Code of the Sith
row.description: The character adheres to the tenets of the Sith philosophy, embracing passion, power, and conflict. This disadvantage might manifest as a compulsion to dominate, a lack of empathy, or a willingness to use any means to achieve their goals. Adherence to this code can lead to escalating violence, betrayal of allies, and ultimately, self-destruction. (GM's discretion on specific points and interpretation based on the character's commitment). Range: -10 or -15 points.
